The following events took place in '''2900 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The small [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]] is founded along a scenic coastline in the northern reaches of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Kallos Sook]] becomes its first [[Regent/Legends|regent]], and hires a large contingent of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to serve as the city's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Founding">{{GalaxiesAED}} stated that Kaadara was founded about one [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the first [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers arrived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the settlers arrived around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]]. This article's date is therefore derived from simple math based on this reference explanation.</ref>
